posts.text:
Attention Young Men:

I am surrounded by 20 year old girls in my life that are smart, capable, hard working and cute.  Nobody is dating them. Not sure what the deal is, but I don’t get it.

Step 1: Stop playing video games

Step 2: Head to great clips and get that lettuce cleaned up

Step 3: Hit a shower (when dating hygiene is critical)

Step 4: Go clean your car

Step 5: Sign up for a yoga class

Step 6: Go to the yoga class

Step 7: Ask a cute for her phone number at yoga class (yes you can meet girls IRL and not just on the apps - 10/10 the Dirt Dog highly recommends)

Step 8: Follow up within 2 days with a phone call and ask them out for this coming weekend Friday or Saturday night.

Step 9: IMPORTANT - come up with a good game plane for date night. Get a dinner reservation, get an activity planned.  Let them know in advance what you are doing so they can dress appropriately.  I know you are gunna roll off the couch and head to date night, but they are not.  They are going to stress about what to wear and call at least 6 different people on FaceTime to ask their opinion.

Step 10: I highly recommend you bring flowers to the door step.  I’m not covering that you go to the doorstep, because if you don’t do that you have no hope here.  Women want men to date them.  You don’t need to break the bank on flowers.  Head to Trader Joe’s.  Grab 2 different kinds of flowers.  If you don’t know what matches find the closest looking lady to your mom at TJ’s and ask her.  Wrap the 2 flowers into 1 bouquet with paper. Bonus Points you can cut open a TJ bag and use that as the paper.

Step 11: Be a gentleman on the date. She isn’t there to hear your life story.  Ask her about her.  For every 1 question you answer, ask her 3.  Open Doors, pay for the meal, be polite.

Provided you follow most of this guideline you are highly likely to get yourself an opportunity for date number 2.

Keep going until you find someone that you can’t imagine not being around all the time.  That’s when you have found a good one for you.

My life is complete with my wife as my companion. I wish you the same fortune in life.  Happy Hunting.

posts.text:
Something feels off with this chorus of “India’s internet is great and super cheap” … the data shows that Indian market is absolutely dominated by mobile. When they say it’s cheap and well connected factually this only applies to mobile usage. 

This makes sense because a tower connects thousands of subs instantly after construction and running fiber is a building by building or resident by resident job. This is also why “fixed wireless” has started growing fast. Follow the incentives. It’s the cheapest and shortest route to revenue. 

Due to this, India is amongst the highest mobile bandwidth usage populations on the planet. 30-40GB/month. (20-50% above US/UK usage) However, home Fiber lines in India pull closer to 300GB/month. 10x gap

For context, that gap in the US and UK is 20-30x. It’s pretty ubiquitous that if you have access to a lot of more bandwidth you will use it. 

Bandwidth abundance does not favor mobile devices. 

I’d argue that it’s not very hard to believe that these paltry sub 5% fixed customer penetration numbers would be much higher if a cost effective alternative existed.

Is that alternative existed it wouldn’t be crazy to expect to see the fixed customer numbers jump from 6% to maybe 10%, 15% or 20%. 100M-200M customers. 

And if the rest of the world is any precedent that would lead to a dramatic increase in overall bandwidth used. 

However, that would mean that mobile bandwidth usage would likely drop or stagnate with in home mobile usage.
